entries.wording: Order created: Label generated
entries.note: The seller printed the label; MailAmericas has not received the parcel.

entries.wording: Tax ID: TN Validation OK
entries.note: A check of the buyer's tax ID, logged with the label. The parcel moves on whatever it says.

entries.wording: Tax ID: Incorrect Buyer ID
entries.note: The same check failing; the page then asks the buyer for the ID. The parcel still moved on in the histories seen.

entries.wording: Tax ID: TAX ID OK
Buyer info: Form Received
entries.note: The buyer's details form, logged again every half hour while the parcel moves on, before and after the last-mile carrier's receipt.

entries.wording: Origin warehouse: Received at Origin Warehouse
Origin warehouse: Dispatched
Origin warehouse: Processed
Hub Transit Warehouse: Received at HUB
entries.note: A transit hub, often in the origin country after the warehouse.

entries.wording: Hub Transit Warehouse: Processed in Hub
Hub Transit Warehouse: Dispatched from Hub
Hub Transit Warehouse: Inspected at hub
In transit to destination country: In transit to the airport
In transit to destination country: Origin customs
entries.note: Export clearance, between the origin warehouse and the flight.

entries.wording: In transit to destination country: Transshipment - Transfer
In transit to destination country: Flight
Arrived to destination country: Delivered by airline
entries.note: The airline handed the parcel over in the destination country.

entries.wording: Arrived to destination country: Customs reception and presentation
Destination customs: Received by Destination Customs
Destination customs: Delayed by customs review
Destination customs: Released
Destination customs: Tax payment accredited
entries.note: The import duty recorded as paid. It came while the parcel was still at the origin warehouse, so it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Destination customs: Hand over to Last Mile Provider
Notification: Additional Information
entries.note: A notice; the page shows its details apart from the history.

entries.wording: WI – Intermediate Warehouse: Container reception
WI – Intermediate Warehouse: Package reception at Intermediate Warehouse
entries.note: A warehouse in the destination country between customs and the last-mile provider.

entries.wording: WI – Intermediate Warehouse: Processed
Received in destination office: Deliver to distributor
Received in destination office: Received by Last Mile Provider
entries.note: The local carrier has the parcel. Its name is in the reply, not the wording, and the adapter does not follow it.

entries.wording: Received in destination office: Sorting center
Received in destination office: Transit to the destination office
Received in destination office: Route rectification
entries.note: Between delivery-office scans; the parcel went back on its way.

entries.wording: Delivery office: Received at Branch
Delivery office: In distribution with postman
Delivery office: Delivery attempt
entries.note: Followed by a return in the history seen; a delivered parcel has a delivery scan instead.

entries.wording: Delivery office: Ready for pick up in delivery office
entries.note: Repeated while the parcel waits; a delivery or a return follows.

entries.wording: Delivery office: Returned for failed delivery
Delivery office: Recipient Absent
Delivery office: Wrong delivery address
entries.note: The parcel went out again and was delivered in the history seen.

entries.wording: Delivery office: Rescheduling
entries.note: After a round with the postman, and again beside the next round, which delivered the parcel; it names no attempt.

entries.wording: Finished: Delivered
Finished: Delivered to return address
Return-Destruction: Received at return Warehouse
Return-Destruction: package ready for destroy
entries.note: After failed deliveries and a return; the summary's status reads returned, which the result takes.
